component.name: ChiralCraft
component.summary: Pure-Rust chemical structure editor, spectroscopy, MedChem, and 3D cheminformatics studio

description.p: ChiralCraft is a free, open-source, pure-Rust desktop chemical structure editor, cheminformatics workbench, CLI batch converter, and Model Context Protocol (MCP) server.

Draw publication-grade ACS 1996 / RSC / Nature / Wiley reaction schemes, predict 1H/13C NMR and FT-IR/UV-Vis spectra, run ADMET/PAINS MedChem scorecards and HRMS isotope envelopes, plan retrosynthesis disconnections, optimize 3D geometries with UFF-Lite, and export lossless editable SVG/PNG/PDF, CDXML, CDX, Molfile V2000/V3000, SDF, SMILES, XYZ, CIF, and LaTeX chemfig.

Major 2D drawing UX fixes (ring drag/previews, ring-closing auto-merge, zig-zag bond clicks, chain attachment, stereobond flip, single-atom drag, eraser stroke) and full multi-backend FT-IR studio with xTB/ORCA/Gaussian/Molden normal modes, JCAMP-DX ASDF/CSV/NIST overlay, and 3D vibration animation.
Initial public release of ChiralCraft 1.0.0 under GNU AGPL-3.0-or-later.
